objective: Backlog execution guardrails: session kickoff/closeout scripts, state machine, AGENTS.md mandatory protocol, quickref doc, and design pre-emption
acceptance_criteria: AGENTS.md has mandatory BACKLOG ITEM EXECUTION PROTOCOL section at top with HARD STOP rule (2-failure block) and 6 ordered steps from kickoff through closeout
scripts/dev/item_kickoff.py: reads item, runs language_rule_review, runs design_guardrails --record, takes usage snapshot, writes .pf-session.json with start_time/session_id/gate_state
scripts/dev/item_closeout.py: reads .pf-session.json, computes duration, applies usage delta, calls set_delivery, prints DoD checklist with pass/fail per item
scripts/dev/session_state.py: state machine with next/status/advance/record-gate-fail/record-gate-pass commands; auto-blocks after 2 consecutive gate failures and 2 review cycles
docs/BACKLOG-EXECUTION-QUICKREF.md: single-page agent reference covering all 6 steps, HARD STOP rule, scope discipline, 6 common gate failures, re-review-on-SHA note
scripts/dev/reconciliation_check.py: advisory check that engineering/designs/<item>.md exists with 5 required sections (PRIOR DECISIONS/EXISTING PATH/ASSUMPTIONS/DIVERGENCES/OPEN QUESTIONS)
scripts/dev/design_completeness_check.py: deterministic completeness check before Gate 1.5, rejecting empty, placeholder, or shallow design sections
scripts/dev/architect_review.py: injects PRIOR REVIEW HISTORY into prompt and applies REVIEW DISCIPLINE requiring concrete runtime consequences for BLOCKER/MAJOR
AGENTS.md protocol includes python scripts/dev/design_guardrails.py --item ID --record as mandatory step between RECONCILIATION block and Gate 1.5 architect review
All new scripts are Python tooling (OK per language rule), have module docstrings, handle missing .pf-session.json gracefully, and work without a running PF API server
